notes.title: Little Mermaid Set & Little Red Riding Hood Lottery
notes.content: [p]Turn the page, for not one but two tales rise from the shadows to be told anew.[/p][p]The first tells of a mermaid, young and curious, who longed for the world of men. She swam near their ships, listened to their songs, watched their strange rituals. Yet the sea is fickle, and human hearts crueller still. One night sailors spied her, cast hooks and hurled harpoons. Dragged aboard and pierced with iron, she slipped away wounded, sinking to the ocean floor. There her love for mankind drowned, and vengeance grew—small as a hatchling, swelling like a great shark. Soon ships began to vanish. Some whispered of a Leviathan. But the old sea-wolves knew: there are no monsters, save those men make for themselves.[/p][p]The second tale tells of a girl in a red cap who went to her grandmother’s house with cakes in her basket and songs on her lips. Days passed, yet she did not return. The villagers marched with torches toward the grandmother’s house. Halfway there they met her—Red Riding Hood. Changed. Taller, shoulders broad, her waist ringed with fangs. Crimson stained her face, and in her gentle hands she carried a hatchet, steady and sure. She smiled still, and sang her whimsical song.[/p][p]And what do these tales bestow upon us? Gaze closely at the images, and you shall see. [/p][p]These stories take shape in the new Set and Lottery—yours to seize.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/efbf0c6103f01a57d32ba706e0e1de2b4234fd8d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/84fe89dd69ff61d10389a2794abf78e3072bb75e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/9d0569cef5c1e29f169f670de55cfae854530c11.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[p]You have known these stories since childhood. Now it’s time to survive their darker side.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/4b0330b1b3eaf1c56ba543746dd3654bc77de13a.png"][/img][/p][p]Once upon a time, there was a maiden of such grace and gentleness that the people of the kingdom called her Snow White. Her lips were red as roses, her hair dark as ebony, her skin pale as fallen snow. Wherever she passed, even the mirrors of her father’s castle seemed to glow.[/p][p][/p][p]But the blessing of beauty weighed on her like a chain. No one saw Sophia, the princess and heiress—they saw only Snow White, a vision to be admired, a name spoken with sighs until her true self was lost. Her bright eyes dulled, her thoughts drifted like mist, and she wandered farther from the castle walls with each passing day. Only a pocket-glass kept her company.[/p][p]Then came famine. The fields withered, the treasury emptied, and the people’s faces grew hollow. Snow White strayed beyond the walls, into the old coal mines, deserted even by the dwarves who once dug there. Save for one, too weary to depart and too stubborn to perish.[/p][p][/p][p]In those black tunnels she lingered, feeding on bitter red apples touched by plague, speaking only to the coughing dwarf and her faithful mirror. No prince came riding to her rescue. Only the Rat King, cast out of the capital, his crown broken, his claws keener than his heart. He found her there, pale as cerement, and spoke a bargain: together they should take the throne, not in wedlock, but in crime.[/p][p][/p][p]Snow White, silent and hollow-eyed, did not gainsay him. The Rat King set her mirror upon a revolver by craft of alchemy and steel, and thereby claimed her trust. With the old dwarf at their side and baskets of poisoned fruit in their hands, they set their steps toward the castle. And Snow White’s gaze, hollow for many years, shone once more.[/p][p][/p][p]The lesson of this tale? Perhaps there is none. But within it lie treasures, and not all of them are make-believe:[/p][p][/p][p]- [b]Snow White[/b]—a princess of sorrowful beauty, now with a tale twisted anew. A happy ending? Such things are seldom told.[/p][p]- [b]The Rat King[/b]—a proud outcast, crownless and cast aside. His own throne was lost, yet he made certain the Nutcracker’s fell as well.[/p][p]- [b]Deadly Reflection[/b]—a [b]revolver [/b]wrought with Snow White’s pocket-glass. She had gazed into it so long that now each shot carries her [b]charms[/b], lulling prey into stillness before the [b]venom [/b]takes them.[/p][p]- [b]Death’s Fruit [/b]— the plague given flesh in the shape of sacred apples. Whoever tastes them is [b]slowed[/b], [b]poisoned[/b], and [b]drained of life[/b]. And the old dwarf tends the harvest still, for this has become his grim calling.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/87f70c8872327f3e302cb4a1af2dc63749ca0b4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Do not close the book too soon, for two more tales are yet to be told.[/p][p][/p][p]The first speaks of a mermaid, young and curious, who longed for the world of men. She swam near their ships, listened to their fisherman’s songs, watched their strange rituals with shining eyes. Yet the sea is fickle, and human hearts are crueller still.[/p][p]One night she was spied by sailors, who cast their hooks and hurled their harpoons. They dragged her aboard, pierced her with iron, and nearly split her open. Yet she slipped away, wounded and silent, and sank to the ocean floor. There her love for mankind drowned, and in its place grew only vengeance — small at first, like a hatchling, but swelling until it filled her like a great white shark.[/p][p]Time passed. Ships vanished. Some whispered of the Leviathan, a monster of the deep. But the oldest sea-wolves knew: there are no monsters in this world, save those men make for themselves.[/p][p]The second tale tells of a girl in a red cap who went to her grandmother’s house. She carried cakes and pies in her basket and sang merry songs as she walked. Days went by, yet she did not return.[/p][p]The wolves had grown bold, circling the village, their snarls reaching even the gates. None dared go searching. Then, as swiftly as they had appeared, the wolves were gone. The villagers lit their torches and shouldered their pitchforks, marching to the grandmother’s house.[/p][p]Halfway there they met her — Little Red Riding Hood. But she was changed. Though only days had passed, she stood taller, her shoulders broad, her waist ringed with gnashing fangs. Crimson stained her face, and in her gentle hands she carried a hatchet, steady and sure. She smiled still, and sang her whimsical song.[/p][p][/p][p]And what do these tales bestow upon us? Well, let’s see:[/p][p]- [b]Little Mermaid[/b]—no longer the helpless child of sorrow, but a bearer of vengeance. And note this: she is only the second avatar without feet—for she never bartered away her tail.[/p][p]- [b]Leviathan Fang[/b]—a [b]heavy [/b]harpoon, [b]pulling [/b]its wielder [b]towards [/b]the foe. Few survive its strike; those who do are left [b]bleeding[/b], and do not linger long.[/p][p]- [b]Little Red Riding Hood[/b]—once a merry girl, now a hardened hunter. She loved her grandmother, and loathed the wolves. Should you meet her on the battlefield, it is you who will need the saving.[/p][p]- [b]Crimson Treat[/b]—a three-barrel [b]shotgun[/b], whose song [b]heals [/b]its wielder and lays low all who dare oppose it.[/p][p]- [b]Red Reaper[/b]—a powerful [b]axe [/b]and a [b]lantern [/b]that burns brighter when foes draw near. Together they are a fell pair.[/p][p]- [b]Silent Howl[/b]—a rifle cloaked in wolfskin. To its master it grants [b]armor [/b]and strikes most [b]critical[/b]. For with each shot, [b]revenge [/b]grows sweeter still.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/51466ad8f24d2cc45145b456ec522d4e8315478a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Time to take a break from scary fairytales—the Final Summer Parties are rolling on, and jam #2 is here: Beach Chorus![/p][p]What’s it like? Picture sunshine, waves, and sandcastles… sounds a bit too idyllic for Pixel Gun 3D, right? Don’t worry—we’ve spiced it up with a little chaos. Your job is to smash those sandcastles and scoop up rewards: guns, bonuses, Pixelpon tags, plus a one-of-a-kind avatar and ride (they look deliciously good).[/p][p]To wreck those sandcastles, you’ll need shovels—yep, the small, bright plastic ones you remember from childhood. And there’s only one place to earn them: the battlefield.[/p][p]F2P-players are getting all the unique prizes plus a chest with a gun. VIP players’ loot list stacked a bit higher: more chests, more guns, more bonuses… and even their own private beach.[/p][p][/p][p]So grab a shovel, hit the sand, and let’s make sure everyone leaves this party loaded and happy![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/a837732977e4cf63c98f7efafede12627eb5d9a1.png"][/img][/p][p]Here it comes—the final power chord of the Final Summer Parties![/p][p][/p][p]The name says it all: you’re invited to the backyard party. But first, you’ll need to rebuild the map to find your way. Need a hint on what to watch for?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Party Booster[/b]—a brand-new, shiny yellow gadget that turns you into a giant, party-hard duck armed with Twin Soakers water blasters. It’s kinda like Robot Samurai or Battle Mech—but with even more punch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Twin Soakers[/b]—a backup with piercing shots that slow and mark your target. Fast, mobile, solid damage, and pure party vibes you can bring to any arena.[/p][p]And don’t forget: the Backyard Reprise activates the Pixelpon event! Tags from the Final Summer Parties give you a shot at the best gear in the game—even the legendary Ultimatum itself.[/p][p][/p][p]All of this—to make sure we close out summer with a bang![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/cb4d569d86a19480f78c0362bb234fdd77890337.png"][/img][/p][p][b]In[/b][/p][p][i]Team Fight:[/i] Asgard, Candy Land[/p][p][i]Deathmatch: [/i]Asgard, Candy Land[/p][p][i]Flag Capture:[/i] Lost World[/p][p][/p][p][b]Out[/b][/p][p][i]Team Fight:[/i] Destroyed Megalopolis, Sawmill [/p][p][i]Deathmatch:[/i] Forge, Sawmill [/p][p][i]Flag Capture: [/i]Aquapark [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/e736fdd6935bb3d8c1ef1c79b89539071f43134f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]- Fixed incorrect behavior of AOE damage for melee weapons[/p][p]- Glitching Hole Weapon: fixed a bug with damage dealt by the gravity sphere[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[p]Chrome, gasoline, and pixels—everything burns in Iron Wastelands. Everything. [/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/45010889e664fdfe5b3d9eea1497e6635017585c.png"][/img][/p][p]The clash with Eddie Mesmer in the L-52 facility didn’t bring closure. Instead, it triggered Track_0, a hidden protocol that scattered the Endless Sand across multiple worlds[/p][p][/p][p]Mesmer slipped away again, vanishing through a portal. With no time to plan, Pixel Man, Daisy, and the Human Rebel followed—straight into a place no one had mapped: the Iron Wastelands. A scorched nowhere of rusted metal, desert heat, and a two-lane blacktop stretching into infinity.[/p][p][/p][p]At the center of it all: The Furnaceborn. His followers call him the Flamefather or the Ember Regent, a fanatic with a vision—bending time and matter into one fused machine at his legendary Time Forge. “Burn or be burned!” is his law. These words still cling to rust-bitten signs, half-buried in ash. Turns out, Furnaceborn used to serve Mesmer. Not anymore: now he’s focused on his own plan—and Mesmer’s in the way. The Furnaceborn wants the hypnotist gone.[/p][p][/p][p]That might sound like luck, but here’s the catch: Furnaceborn thinks our heroes are a threat too. While he mobilizes his patrols, Pixel Man and the others have to stay ahead—find Mesmer, recover the Endless Sand, and keep it out of the wrong hands. Because if Furnaceborn gets it first, reshaping the Wastelands might be the least of our problems. He’s got the forge. He’s got the will. And he just might have enough insanity to collapse the entire Pixel Universe.[/p][p][/p][p]Watch out for:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Elian The Guder[/b]—sharp-eyed navigator, ruthless scout, and trigger-happy menace. A genius behind the wheel and a total maniac in the head.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dusty Rover[/b]—V8 engine, twin flame-spitters, roll cage, and armor plate slabs. This ain’t a ride—it’s a runaway freight train on third gear, built to bulldoze through purgatory.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Blazefanner[/b]—a mangled, metal-backed freakshow of a weapon. Slows you down, lights you up, and fries anything big enough to twitch inside its scope. Brutal doesn’t begin to cover it.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Technician Greer[/b]—if it shoots, burns, or explodes, Greer probably made it. Even the Time Forge itself was cooked up in that cracked head of his. He’s not a technician—he’s a walking war lab.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Prototype Chainsaw Rifle[/b]—Greer’s love letter to chaos. A sniper rifle that shoots high-voltage bolts. Comes with X-ray vision and chain damage so nasty, even the Wastelands flinch when it hums.[/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/5125c1eaf3952b0100da799dd0fc51f1d16d7ffc.png"][/img][/p][p]More heat from the Wastelands![/p][p][/p][p][b]Drazz[/b]—the wildcard in Furnaceborn’s inner circle. Ragebringer? Strategist? Court jester? Nobody’s sure—not even Drazz. But one thing’s clear: this twisted freak is as unstable as a blast fuse on a short timer. Approach with caution—or better yet, don’t.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tremor Vox[/b]—Drazz’s favorite sidearm. A pistol with a pulse, it feeds on precision. Every headshot amps its damage, making it more unhinged with every pull of the trigger. They call this attribute Headshot Rage. You’ll see why.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The Furnaceborn[/b]—the Flamefather himself. Ruler of the Iron Wastelands. Half prophet, half war machine. Avoid at all costs: this guy isn’t particularly famous for taking prisoners.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rebar Sling[/b]—Furnaceborn’s go-to when subtlety isn’t even on the table. A brutal slingshot that fires hunks of scrap and rebar. Fast, ricocheting, and known for nasty gashing wounds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rusty Reaper[/b]—a long-range rifle fueled by a volatile core. Comes loaded with X-ray Vision, so you’re never really hidden.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Scorching Mauler[/b]—the final word in firepower. The Furnaceborn’s personal flame canon. This isn’t a flamethrower—it’s a walking inferno. Slow, heavy, devastating—and beyond anything words can handle.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/5b6333c61bfa953b167941bcc93a5893ef911cbc.png"][/img][/p][p]In the post-apocalypse, might makes right—but that doesn’t mean you can’t show off some style while you’re at it. And during Emberfest, you’ve got two ways to blaze your trail.[/p][p][/p][p]Got spare currency? Hit the in-game shop, grab whatever you want, and earn Festival Coupons as cashback. Stack enough, and you can trade 'em for all kinds of loot—including the headline prize: the ruthless Ember Gut melee weapon.
[/p][p]Low on funds, high on fire? No problem. Dominate in matches to earn Pyroids and swap them for rewards—plus a one-of-a-kind avatar to prove you burned your way through.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/2b75eb41bff034d126ccc279321589cb36887cfa.png"][/img]
[/p][p]We’ve crossed summer’s midpoint. Autumn’s creeping in with cooler moods and slower moves—but not yet. There’s still time to go loud. To party like it’s doomsday’s eve.That’s where the Final Summer Parties come in! Three linked events with top-tier rewards. Three parties you can’t miss. Three chances to turn what’s left of summer into a mixtape to remember.[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/0d31f427127c4c0d2b01cc3ed7180aa6f4b7db03.png"][/img][/p][p]The first beat in the Final Summer Parties mixtape. Here's how the rhythm flows:[/p][p][/p][p]- Step into the lift [/p][p]- Let your skill do the climbing. Floor by floor, frag by frag[/p][p]- Claim your rewards[/p][p]- Then hit the rooftop—where the view hits back[/p][p]
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/f6d9a8ee8d11afc214ea06cf3e0339d671c91b5e.png"][/img][/p][p]A sweet, old-school capsule machine loaded with prizes every pixelgunner wants. You get the hint, right? [/p][p][/p][p]You’ll see it in the lobby—but you won’t get access. Not yet. Pixelpon unlocks toward the end of the Final Summer Parties. The better you perform in the event series, the more precious capsules you’ll earn. Just to make sure summer ends with a BANG. So don’t sit on your hands during the event series.[/p][p]

notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Gear up smart. Go tactical. Initiate Echo Protocol. Survive the op—if you can.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/91a5b0086d0be737b20341116b39ed186a67ab81.png"][/img]
[/p][p]L-52. Most in the Pixel Universe haven’t even heard the name.[/p][p]
A few brilliant minds across different worlds once ran the numbers and came up with a wild theory: somewhere out there, time could be controlled. They never reached it, but the idea was too tempting to ignore. Eventually, a few military groups got involved. Funded off-books and buried deep in \[classified] forest, they built an L-52 facility in \[classified]—a zone where secret experiments were run to bend and sync timelines using satellites and signal relays. No oversight. No ethics. Just decades of unchecked research. And progress—scary progress.[/p][p]
Then, one day, it all stopped.[/p][p]
The barracks, the labs, the relays—they’re still there. Still powered. But the soldiers, scientists, and support crews are long gone. Only unfinished experiments remain—silent, dangerous, and waiting like crocodiles for anyone reckless enough to get close.[/p][p]
After breaking free of Mesmer’s control, [b]Ramlisa [/b]used the Timeless Sands to open a portal. Now our heroes are here. L-52. The problem is, Eddie Mesmer got here first. And even the pixel gods don’t know what’s going on in that twisted head of his. Pixel Man, Daisy, and the Human Rebel have to track him down. Fast.[/p][p]
And Mesmer’s not the only thing waiting in this place. L-52 may be forgotten, but it’s still very much alive.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Captain Sower[/b]—possibly on an official military op. But no one knows for sure.[/p][/*][*][p]He’s armed with the [b]Dustpiercer DMR[/b]—a fast, mobile sniper rifle enhanced with [b]Target Mark[/b] and a [b]bleeding [/b]effect. Efficient. Precise. Cold.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ironside[/b]—once part of Sower’s squad. Scratch that—he is the squad. A soldier through and through, Ironside sees only targets. Anything in his path—irrelevant.[/p][/*][*][p]His weapon of choice: the [b]VX-9 Linehold[/b], a brutal, [b]3CatSpam-friendly[/b] grenade launcher backed by a damage-reflecting [b]shield[/b]. Whatever Sower’s digging for in L-52, Ironside’s job is simple—make sure no one gets close.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/fac201bd5eed6855fad9f86ac5e444bab86dcdfb.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]If you think that’s it—think again. Mesmer didn’t waste time after arriving at L-52. Somehow, he managed to bring Perimeter-9 to his side.[/p][p]
If mercs, headhunters, and private armies had a boogeyman, they’d call it Perimeter-9. Officially labeled a squad of nine mercenaries—but they serve no flag, follow no orders, and chase a goal known only to themselves. Chaotic. Unpredictable. Absolutely merciless. Born and bred in L-52—if such concepts even apply to them.[/p][p]
They were the result of a canceled military experiment: Project P9 (Phantasm). The idea was direct—create a squad of supersoldiers, loyal as tools and deadly as a grenade with the pin pulled. They were meant for deep deployment across timelines, with orders to carry out operations no one else could even survive. As usual, the funding dried up. The experiment needed pharma experts; high command got stingy. You can guess the rest.[/p][p]
The nine subjects—written off, marked for liquidation—turned the tables. They vanished into the deep forest of \[classified], dragging their experimental gear and tactical enhancements with them. Now they operate off the grid—unshackled, undirected, and armed with tech no one can trace. Whatever they were meant to be, they’ve become Perimeter-9 instead.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Callsign "Bratfox”[/b]—the most notorious in the unit. Handles diversion, demolition, and solo neutralization of superior enemy elements. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Shattermark[/b]—Bratfox’s personal sniper rifle. Built for brutal efficiency. Features [b]X-ray[/b] optics and [b]gadget suppression[/b]. Some say [b]victims eliminated [/b]by this rifle [b]detonate[/b]—but that’s just a story, right?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Silent Fang[/b]—a standard sidearm for Perimeter-9. [b]Blinds [/b]targets, [b]blocks jumps[/b], and comes with an unsettling edge—[b]Instant Reload[/b]. After five hits, the gun seems to reload itself. Nobody’s sure how. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Tricky Maple[/b]—shaped like a maple leaf. Functions like a [b]cluster grenade[/b]—with a hint of [b]target-seeking[/b] behavior.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Time Forester[/b]—the only face in L-52 you might consider a friend. If you're lucky. No one knows who's under the camouflage, but they've called this zone home for decades. At least. Stay on their side. Otherwise, Mesmer won’t be your biggest problem.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Root Piercer[/b]—a semi-auto carbine with [b]piercing [/b]rounds, [b]blind[/b], and [b]curse [/b]effects. High control, tight rhythm—only six shots per reload. Demands precision. Perfect for isolating targets and shutting them down, one cursed bullet at a time.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/9fd06d31d3ea35f82e86862a75d27b1cc2e07a40.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][p]// CLASSIFIED //[/p][p]JOINT SIGNAL OPERATIONS COMMAND[/p][p]OPERATIONAL BRIEFING — CODE: ECHO
[/p][p]MISSION TITLE: CTF Ops[/p][p]OPERATIONAL STATUS: Standby[/p][p]CLEARANCE LEVEL: Alpha-5 (Command & Field Only)[/p][p]INITIATION WINDOW: 0800 ZULU, 03.07 — 0800 ZULU, 14.07[/p][p]LOCATION: L-52 Sector \[classified][/p][p]OBJECTIVE: Capture the Flag[/p][p]DETAILS: Intel provided in sealed squad packets. Open only post-deployment at designated start hour.[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/a1941239322c1186c9f2c1b48decad00ee83967b.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Shooting ranges can be found in every major city across the Pixel Universe—and, of course, L-52 has one too. Decades of abandonment left it a little rough around the edges, but it’s still fully automatic and operational.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s the official instruction.[/p][p]
Location: Sector L-52 Range Unit // Auto-System ID: PX-TR-982[/p][p]Status: Operational (aging infrastructure; full auto-target sync confirmed)[/p][p]
[/p][p]HOW TO USE[/p][olist][*][p]Join Active Combat Zones[/p][/*][/olist][p]Engage in standard PvP battles to earn designated training rounds.
[/p][p]2. Collect Bullets[/p][p]Each win, assist, or action may reward you with authorized range ammunition.
[/p][p]3. Access the Range[/p][p]Bring collected bullets to the shooting range. Load them into the auto-feeder and begin your training.[/p][p]4. Hit the Targets[/p][p]Accuracy matters. The sharper your shots, the better your results.
[/p][p]REWARDS SYSTEM[/p][p]Prove your aim to receive exclusive gear:[/p][list][*][p]Sharpshooter’s Hat[/p][/*][*][p]Sharpshooter’s Boots
[/p][/*][/list][p]VIP ACCESS[/p][p]VIP Pass holders unlock access to a classified sector of the range. Includes additional targets and premium-tier rewards.[/p][p]

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/02d6ca3e1c9a89c4dffab59975d519516239a859.png"][/img][/p][p]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/b222b41cecba6608a7421743cdf20c429bb20546.png[/img]

Pixel Man, Daisy, Human Rebel, and their fellow pixelgunners managed to bring the system back on its feet after the Crash—an attack orchestrated by none other than Eddy Mesmer. But the damage ran deeper than they expected. While patching up the Creator’s PC, the squad discovered something far more alarming: a rift leading to another world.

And not just any world—[b]the Golden Sands[/b]. A mysterious realm where the [b]Hourglass Watcher[/b] resides, guarding the flow of time and protecting the timelines of the entire Pixel Universe.

But Eddy had already left his mark. The master hypnotist got there first and corrupted [b]Ramlisa[/b], Queen of the Sands and Matriarch of the Ard Al-Mazahib kingdom. Under his control, the once-noble sovereign now leads her forces in a war against the Hourglass Keeper.

What a cruel twist of fate! Pixel Man, Daisy, and Human Rebel have entered the realm of time itself—and time is the one thing they don’t have. If they fail, the Hourglass will shatter, Time’s heartbeat will cease, and all worlds will fall into eternal stillness.

Fortunately, they’re not alone. Reinforcements are on the way—and the sands are far from silent.

[list]
[*] [b]Sands Hunter Khamsin. [/b]A silent tracker born of the dunes. He hunts with ancient instincts and answers only to the desert winds.
[*] [b]Azhar the Djinn.[/b] Once bound to forgotten ruins, Azhar now channels timeless power as a proud member of the pixel squad. Also fun fact: he’s our first avatar without feet!
[*] [b]Sandbite.[/b] A Special-class weapon that fuses the mystic essence of timeless sand with modern firepower. It launches explosive orbs of sand dust that blind and slow enemies. The scorpion form is a sanam mutaharrik—a kind of clay-forged golem. No animals are harmed in the process, promise.
[*] [b]Desert's Judgement.[/b] At first glance, it looks like a saif—but don’t be fooled. This is a fully automatic rifle. Instead of bullets, it fires compressed grains of timeless sand. It needs reloading, sure—but you’re never truly out of ammo.
[*] [b]Golden Wishblade. [/b]A rare, elite version of the Desert’s Judgement—crafted exclusively for the arbab al-amwal, the wealthiest citizens of the Ard Al-Mazahib kingdom.
[*] [b]Little Raakib. [/b]An exceptionally well-trained fennec fox who rides a Damun—a massive, flesh-eating sand worm endemic to the harsh dunes of Ard Al-Mazahib. Cute? Definitely. Dangerous? Absolutely.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/3c674444493f4ed1bcd806934685da359c10c201.png[/img]

In this update’s Set and Lottery, you’ll get a closer look at the many sides of the Chrono-Conflict.

[list]
[*] [b]Queen Ramlisa. [/b]Fair, decisive, and radiantly beautiful, Ramlisa once ruled the Ard Al-Mazahib kingdom with grace and wisdom. But even the strongest minds aren’t immune to manipulation—Eddy Mesmer’s hypnotic interference has clouded her judgment, pushing her into a war not her own.
[*] [b]Gilded Gaze.[/b] A royal sidearm that fires charming, ricocheting laser beams wrapped in violet light. 3CatSpammers—take note.
[*] [b]Hourglass Watcher. [/b]No one knows their name. No one knows where they came from. But one thing is certain: without the Watcher’s sacred duty, Time—and the Pixel Universe—would cease to exist.
[*] [b]Woundweaver.[/b] At first glance, just a long wind-scarf adorned with traditional Ard Al-Mazahib patterns. On second glance—a ruthless melee weapon, capable of bleeding out multiple enemies in seconds.
[*] [b]Desert Verdict. [/b]As merciless as the desert itself. This sniper rifle converts timeless sand into searing laser beams, with a high rate of fire to pin down enemies at range. And if someone gets too close, the reload triggers a secret (and painful) close-range defense mechanism.
[*] [b]Grimoire of Ruin.[/b] The most sacred—and feared—book of the Golden Sands. Legend says it was written by a daughter of the sandcaller tribe’s last elder, shortly before her tragic demise. The tribe was wiped out decades ago—falsely accused of treason. But the grimoire survived, carrying within it the power to summon the rage of timeless sand. 3CatSpammers—yes, take another note.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/6cced748a763d1986b55145b9c094b1183d1d402.png[/img]

notes.title: Pixel Gun 2 Q&A
notes.content:
Wow. Just—wow.

We expected some hype around the Pixel Gun 2 reveal—but not this level of energy! You absolutely blew us away. Huge thanks for making our announcement & teaser launch unforgettable.

We know you’ve got a lot of questions and thoughts. Today, we’ll answer the five most common ones—but more Q&As are coming, and we’ll get to everything that matters.

[b]1️⃣ Will you continue supporting Pixel Gun 3D after the release of Pixel Gun 2?[/b]

Absolutely: PG3D isn’t being replaced. It’s part of the Pixel Universe we’re expanding. Both games will grow side by side—with updates, content, and support for both communities.

[b]2️⃣ Will real-money purchases give an unfair advantage in Pixel Gun 2?[/b]

We heard all your feedback from Classic PG3D — and we’re doing things differently this time. Pixel Gun 2 focuses on skill, fair balance, and a better in-game economy.

[b]3️⃣ Will PG2 be available on mobile devices?[/b]

Yes, Pixel Gun 2 will launch simultaneously on iOS, Android, and Steam.

[b]4️⃣ Will there be anti-cheat at launch?[/b]

Yes, from day one. Dedicated servers with dynamic system checks, all-new security framework, gRPC protocol—everything’s built to keep your matches fair, competitive, and clean.

[b]5️⃣Will there be an account / progress transfer from PG3D to PG2?[/b]

Pixel Gun 2 is a completely new game — with new mechanics, an updated progression system, and a fair, well-designed economy—so data transfer isn’t possible. It’s a fresh start where every player starts on equal ground. But we’ve got some surprise gifts for Classic PG veterans!

notes.title: Lock & Load
notes.content:
Hey, we all love the chaos in the arenas. But sometimes, it's nice to slow things down. No boom-booms, no mid-air rocket weirdos, no chat spam—just you, the crosshair, and a target.

Welcome to the Lock & Load shooting range! Crack some shots in a clean setup and get dope stuff like a unique mask and cape for landing those bullseyes.

The only thing is—you need special ammo to play. And the only way to earn this special ammo is to get some frags the old-school way. You know, with boom-booms, mid-air rocket weirdos, and chat spam. Every 10 kills = 1 round at the range.

The Lock & Load event is 100% free-to-play. All the main rewards—the mask, the cape, and all the useful extras—you earn with your skill alone. But if you get the pass, you'll unlock a VIP zone with soundproof walls and even bigger prizes inside.

So lock, load, and fire at will!

While Pixelman was busy searching for a way out of the Backrooms, things in his hometown of San Blockcisco took a dramatic turn.

For years, the FROST system, run by advanced AI, kept the city’s weather and seasons in perfect balance. But when the CEO of the FROST Corporation devised a sinister plan to take over the system, the entire city fell under their icy control.

Now, San Blockcisco is trapped in eternal winter. The people toil under the corporation’s rule, and Christmas is just a distant memory. The city’s only hope lies with the hacker duo IC3BR3AK3RS—Eliot the MAD and Ellie. Armed with sharp technical skills and custom-built weapons, they’re ready to fight back, whether online or on the frost-covered streets of their beloved city.

The Robo-Elf Assistant Set features the Christmas Delivery automatic rifle with the Berserk attribute: the lower your health and armor, the more damage you inflict.

In the IC3BR3AK3RS Lottery, you’ll find the Backstabbers, equipped with the Backstab attribute. This melee weapon deals significantly more damage when attacking from behind.

These new weapons are designed to add variety to battles, rewarding pixelgunners who can fully unlock their potential. And this is only the beginning—soon, even more attributes will be yours to explore.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/77c7939fdce2209ab22afb1ba7899be7a5dbf638.png[/img]

Every year, Santa loads up his sleigh, gathers his reindeer, and sets off on his magical route to deliver gifts to everyone who’s been good all year. But this time, something went terribly wrong!

A tiny miscalculation left Santa’s reindeer without their much-needed portion of berries, and now they’re struggling to pull the gift-laden sleigh through the icy night air.

Pixelgunners, it’s time to save Christmas! Jump into the action, collect cranberries in matches, and feed the reindeer to help them complete their journey. Of course, such a noble effort comes with a magical reward: the all-new Crystal Christmas Armor set and the festive Crystal Annihilator gun.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/36548a736b1a8dbb12a300f6cb96cd4dea1f4f37.png[/img]

Ruby—the color of luxury, elegance, and Black Friday. Step into the most glamorous event of the year: Ruby Glow!

Earn Ruby Coupons with every in-game store purchase, including—for the first time ever—purchases made with coins and Pixel Pass tickets. Use your coupons to claim an exclusive avatar, the stunning yet highly effective Ruby Armor, and the devastatingly powerful Ruby Shotgun.

The fan-favorite PGA season returns, bringing chills and thrills! Expect eerie new weapons inspired by the strangest SCP Foundation anomalies, plus a special Pixel Pass treat—the Teleporting Relic gadget that completely redefines mobility on the battlefield. Finally, Update 24.9 will conclude the major storyline arc surrounding the search for Pixel Man.

[b]Lore[/b]

It turns out those surreal fungal dreams were just a simulated simulation. Daisy awakens in the lab of the PGA—a special agency dedicated to capturing, containing, and destroying dangerous anomalies. The agents know Pixel Man is trapped in the dark depths of the Backrooms, and they’re ready to arm Daisy with whatever it takes to break him free. But there’s a trick to this treat: Daisy must help PGA face the most dangerous anomalies in the Backrooms, threats that could haunt not only San Blockcisco but the entire planet.

The most successful defenders will earn a reward from the mayor—a new weapon, the Anomaly Compass automatic rifle, equipped with a locator to track down enemies.

notes.content:
Hey, pixelgunners!

We've seen a lot of your messages about older weapons not being as effective as the new ones, legendary weapons always losing to mythical, and the current meta forcing you to rely on a narrow set of guns instead of experimenting with the hundreds available.

We're aware of the weapon balance issues and share your concerns. We all want Pixel Gun 3D to be a competitive and fun shooter. That’s why we’re working on improving the current balance, equalizing all weapons based on time-to-kill, categories, types, rarity, and unique nuances and characteristics of particular guns. There are many changes, but they all aim to make the game fairer and more competitive.

We’ve done extensive internal testing, and now we’re ready to share the results of our work with you. We're preparing a global playtest where every pixelgunner can participate and share their thoughts on the new weapon balance. We want to get this started as soon as possible, so keep an eye on your mailbox and our social media!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/04b178f17ec2532baf10d0dff4a7bf7034a18fc3.png[/img]

In the new update, you will visit a mysterious forest filled with glowing mushrooms, strange creatures, and, of course, the most dreamlike weapons. You will find the new guns, inspired by fluorescent fungi and insects, hence chitin elements and poisonous attributes. And finally, with Daisy and Black Dragon by your side, you’ll take the next step in the search for Pixel Man story arc.

[b]Lore[/b]

After their exhausting journey through Mictlan, Daisy and the Black Dragon find themselves in a mysterious fungi forest. Daisy merely touched an unfamiliar mushroom—it was glowing too brightly to resist. But that one touch was enough to stir the entire forest. Everything around them shimmered with a strange ripple and pulsed in a unified rhythm.

For Daisy and the Black Dragon, that rhythm meant only one thing—the beginning of another adventure. One they would certainly return from, equipped with never-before-seen weapons.

The local beetles can be crafted into a poisonous Beetles Wand. The glowing mushrooms, able to shine through walls, are perfect for small-caliber weapons. The Hypno Frog’s ability to shift gravitational fields turns it into a deadly gadget, while the Dandelion’s explosive seeds transform the flower into compact artillery.

But that’s all in theory. The most interesting things happen in practice, and the mysterious mushroom forest is the ideal testing ground!

Of course, your efforts will be rewarded with unique prizes: the new Berry-Ball gadget, the special Petal Pyro gun, and a skin that completely changes its attributes.

[b]Lore[/b]

The pixelgunners defeated Ash Lord and his fiery minions. The Tree of Life was saved, and the raging forest fires were finally extinguished. Yet, even these heroic efforts weren’t enough: thick smoke from the charred remains covered the sky, shrouding the world in an impenetrable fog that blocked out the sun. Only the light of the Shining Flowers can cut through the haze and restore the pixel planet.

notes.title: Update 24.6
Patch Note 24.6
notes.content:
Let's turn up the heat this summer with a road trip back to the 2000s, a new reporting system, weapons designed by our most talented pixelgunners, and so much more! Ready to roll?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/c90e85829fa4d7611fc00ea013b74724ade823ca.png[/img]

In the wake of the epic showdown, the situation was finally looking up. Portalius, the mad genius, was defeated, and the unpredictable Eddie Mesmer had pulled back – at least for now.

But one problem remained: Pixelman was still lost in the eerie depths of the Backrooms. Time was running out. The longer he stayed trapped, the slimmer the chances of rescue. With no room for error, Daisy and the Black Dragon harnessed Portalius' tech and the Multiverse shards to build a portable Portal Hub. This high-tech device could theoretically jump through time, space, and the unknown fabrics of the Multiverse itself.

But here's the twist: Portalius' reputation as a genius wasn't for nothing. Building a working device from his plans was a beast of a challenge. Daisy messed up the settings, and instead of landing in the Backrooms, she and the Black Dragon found themselves in the early 2000s – inside someone's computer!

The mission? Still the same: fix the Hub and get to the Backrooms. But first, Daisy and her companion had to break out of this retro digital world, where characters from old video games, movies, and anime ran the show. And not all of them were happy to see intruders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/22942a516b930a6a9ca0835d31cedb945fa259f0.png[/img]

In April, we launched the "Your Weapon in the Game'' contest. Despite the name, pixelgunners could submit their creations in any form: weapons, avatars, gadgets, gliders, trails, and more. The grand prize was having their dream concept come true within the game.

In our new event, we imagined what a pixelgunner's workshop might look like. As part of the "Project Task," you'll need to gather parts to create the event's main rewards – guns, an avatar, and a glider. These are the items designed by our players in the contest.

You can collect parts in battles within the marked game modes on designated maps, as well as through purchases in the in-game store. Don’t miss the chance to enhance your Armory with these unique items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/2b6244af62d0a4549fe2788f60db6ad070ca2f82.png[/img]

As part of our fight against cheaters, we've reworked the reporting system. Now you can report dishonest players with just a few clicks, without even quitting the match. Simply select the reason from a list during the kill cam window or from the player table before or after the match, and our support team will receive your report immediately. Each player can send up to 10 reports per day.

This means cheaters will be identified and banned more quickly, as they will be flagged for our anti-cheat system. And what is more, your reports will play a crucial role in improving and tailoring our anti-cheat measures. We’re working together to make our favorite shooter safe and fair for everyone.

This is just one of many upcoming tools of our anti-cheat system, and we will keep you informed about further steps and improvements, so keep an eye out for our social media to be the first ones to know.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/ba4240d8361ab804ec8e9036cc4cd601f0f8a98a.png[/img]

PC Edition players, get ready for some crisp new Steam achievements!

For seasoned pixelgunners, hitting 100% completion will be a breeze, and nothing beats that ever-satisfying sound and a pop-up message when you unlock an achievement.

For newcomers, though, it's a different story. Those picking up the Pixel Gun for the first time and chasing achievements have a long and curvy road ahead.

Ultimately, this journey will help rookies have a hand in shooting, explore various game modes, and master the nuances of different weapon categories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/0e8e7be6ee172c6fc8e6b2aa2b6960faa3bb3a69.png[/img]

[b]Clan Refinements[/b]

We have some notable changes lined up for clan players in update 24.6 to improve this aspect of the game.

We’ve upgraded the Clan War registration process. Previously, only the clan leader and the officers had access to the Clan War registration. Now, this option is available to every member by default, although it can be disabled in the clan settings.

Secondly, we've reworked the search system, so finding a clan now should be as easy as it gets. To simplify things even more, you can automatically join a clan that meets your criteria with just a click.

[b]Tournament Mode Tweaks[/b]

Tournament mode has also received some updates. Based on your feedback, we've adjusted the reward balance, expanded the number of prize spots on the leaderboard, and improved the interface. Soon, we plan to limit the roster of weapons available for the Tournament.
[b]
Event Center Enhancements[/b]

We've refined the animations, notifications, and icons within the Event Center to make it easier to access information about each game activity (Events, Sets, Lucky Board). No more double-tapping to get straight to the Event. The Lottery icon has come back in the Lobby, so you no longer need to enter the Event Center to get a weapon from a chest, though this option is still available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/8d60d6d60ec5e182acd2410126cf03d90307aeb4.png[/img]

As usual, with the new update, we're shuffling the list of available arenas. In Team Fight, D-Day and Candyland will replace Mafia Cottage and Chinatown. In Deathmatch mode, Scarab Temple will give way to Slender Forest. Finally, Sawmill will stand in for Area 51 in Point Capture.

notes.title: Post-Release News and Q&A #1
notes.content:
That’s just a jaw-dropper! Thank you, pixelgunners, for making this release happen! The party you threw will eternize this moment of pixel glory (our servers will definitely not forget it). In the past day, we achieved incredible results: 25,000 online on Steam – that's top-50 online across the entire platform. We did all this together: each of you contributed to this great success. New challenges and new heights to conquer await us ahead.

Special thanks for your detailed feedback. We see all your messages and are already working on key improvements:

[list]
[*] Logging into the game and getting into the match problems – this is our top priority. Of course, we knew that you wanted the PC Edition bad, but we didn't expect THAT BAD!
[*] Adjusting the volume of sound effects – we received many requests about this on the release day. Also one of the first candidates for fixing.
[*] The possibility to turn off sound in the game on the server queue screen – already working on it.
[*] Gamepad recognition on handheld consoles – every pixelgunner deserves to play the way they find comfortable.
[*] Key mapping for keyboards and controllers – the second most popular request. Very soon, you will have the opportunity to assign keys at your discretion.
[*] Moving during viewing the Scoreboard – a small but annoying bug. We're fixing it on the double.
[*] Locking the Scoreboard on gamepads – adding players to your friendlist is physically inconvenient right now. And friendship is magic, so we're fixing it urgently.
[*] Graphics settings – the main section in any PC shooter. Very soon, we will add the option to disable motion blur and bloom in the Settings menu.
[/list]
All these improvements will gradually appear in game patches. Patches will be released regularly, and you can read about all the changes in the News in the Community Hub on Steam or on our [url=https://discord.gg/pixelgun3d]Discord[/url].
 
These are our short time plans. What can you expect in the future? Well, for instance, you will definitely get Steam achievements, stickers, cards, and badges, a full support checkmark for Steam Deck, as well as adding friends and inviting them to the game using your Friendlist on Steam.

We also noticed that you are not quite familiar with our Help Center: questions about account transfer topped the support chart. In this regard, we have prepared a small [url=https://support.pixelgun3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17949087486365-Transferring-Pixel-Gun-3D-Account-to-PC-Frequently-Asked-Questions]Q&A[/url] on the most popular questions. 

You can find a detailed guide on account transfer in a separate [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2524890/view/4202494859459818029?l=english]news article[/url] on Steam or in our [url=https://support.pixelgun3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17864564895261-How-can-I-transfer-my-account-progress-to-the-Steam-version]Help Center[/url].

On behalf of the entire PG3D team, thanks again to all of you for the support, fun, frags, memorable moments, in a word, for everything! We couldn't have done it without you!

notes.title: Account Transfer Guide
notes.content:
The release of PG3D PC Edition is just a few days away! This is the perfect time to discuss how to transfer your account from your mobile device to Steam. While it's certainly possible to start from level 0 and work your way up to level 65 again, discovering new and exciting things along the way, many Pixelgunners will want to transfer their progress, Armory, pets, and other rewards to their PC. And so, we've created a detailed guide to help you through the process.

Please note that you must have game [b]version 24.4.5[/b] installed on your mobile device to transfer your progress to Steam!

To transfer your progress to Steam, you'll need to follow these steps:

[b]On mobile devices[/b]:

[b]Step 1[/b]: Setting Up

[list]
[*] Open the in-game settings on your mobile device.
[*] Look for the Account Transfer or Deletion button in the game settings on your device and tap on it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/f5f8262a4bf86ad897a5ac110358e5bbb1b5a91a.png[/img]

[b]Step 2[/b]: Initiate Transfer

[list]
[*] Select the Transfer ID option.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/48a031d689c909e6f4b474914c531467c0866aeb.png[/img]

[b]Step 3[/b]: Generate the Code

[list]
[*] Generate a password for transferring progress.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/a99d434fbdf1c3691d4b411208cc41e9aac65a28.png[/img]

[b]On PC[/b]:

[b]Step 4:[/b] Setting Up

[list]
[*] Open the in-game settings on the PC.
[*] Look for the Account Transfer or Deletion button in the game settings on PC and click on it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/9411816b25c576ed7e5f8d8cb468ff679fa72ab7.png[/img]

[b]Important note[/b]: when you first launch the game on a PC, a window will open with the choice between starting a new game or synchronizing your progress from your mobile device. From this menu, you can select the option that suits you and transfer your game progress from a mobile device to a computer.

[b]Step 5[/b]: Initiate Transfer

[list]
[*] Select the Transfer ID option.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/ab0645124b5778d2ac257c93fe897fa1b753dbc7.png[/img]

[b]Step 6:[/b] Transferring progress from the mobile version of the game

[list]
[*] Enter the generated code from the mobile version of the game
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/5abdb3accf0c8b1505e5b618c2e9844d933e07f4.png[/img]

[b]Step 7[/b]: Choose Your Account

[list]
[*] Select the Replace option to choose your old PG account.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/94126af11814bd3873e81b8bf6efd9e81cb5b72f.png[/img]

[b]Step 8[/b]: Confirm Progress Transfer
By clicking Continue you acknowledge the potential account loss for the account created on the new device.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44453777/3a7ccccf7d6af2d3ca478341e73473a5fff24502.png[/img]

[b]Step 9[/b]: Enjoy Your Progress

[list]
[*] Your old progress will now be available on your PC.
[*] You might encounter a Connection Error on your old device due to the limitation of using one PG3D account across multiple devices simultaneously. Click Reconnect to regain access to your transferred account on your old device, and a similar window will appear on your PCr/Huawei device.
[/list]

[b]Important note[/b]: When transferring progress from a mobile device to the Steam version of the game, your previous progress from the Steam version of the game will be completely overwritten without the possibility of restoring.

Account transfer from Steam to other platforms is currently unavailable. Additionally, you can only link one in-game account to your Steam account.

It is important to emphasize that when you transfer your game progress between different platforms (for example, between Google Play and Steam/AppGallery) your account will automatically synchronize with each of them. This means that you can start playing on one platform, such as Steam, and seamlessly continue on your mobile device, and vice versa.

[b]​​Important Tips[/b]:
[list]
[*] If your game progress is not linked to your store account (Google Play, App Store, etc.), it will be lost during the transfer.
[*] Selling, gifting, trading to third parties or any other forms of assignment violates our Terms of Service and may lead to permanent account termination. These actions are strictly prohibited.
[/list]

Almost a complete port of the mobile version: we removed old and unused content from the code, but otherwise it's the same PG3D you know and love — a dynamic, competitive, insane, and completely free first-person shooter.

You can transfer all your progress from mobile devices to PC, so experienced Pixelgunners won't have to start over.

So mark your calendars: PG3D PC Edition will be released on April 2nd.

What do you need to know about the Steam version right now?

First, a separate team is working on the port. This way, we maintain mobile version support without being distracted by other developments.

Secondly, PG3D: PC Edition will be almost a complete port of the mobile version. Why almost? We will remove 3-5% of content that became obsolete a long time ago. It will help us speed up the PC version development and also have a positive effect on optimization. Other than that, it will be the same Pixel Gun 3D that you love so much.

Of course, there is more news we have prepared for you. Surely, you are interested in whether it will be possible to transfer progress from the mobile version to the PC.
